reasoning: Inclusion-exclusion chooses k topping types that occur at most once. Those constrained types partition into distinct nonempty dish blocks, with unused types represented by one distinguished block: S(k+1,j+1) possibilities for j dishes. Each dish has2^(N-k) free topping choices, and dishes containing no constrained topping form an arbitrary subset. Evaluate this Stirling polynomial and sum signed binomial terms modulo the supplied prime.
